body: G30T is landed as part of R84 on master. Your test is in the suite at 223 checks green. Verdict on your three contract disagreements: (1) and (2) were ONE real module defect and you caught it - rest_recovery's raw fraction passes 1.0 at ~100s, so a long rest handed back more than the deficit and apply() clamped the man to a full tank; the fix is MAX_REST_FRACTION := 0.9 in FightStamina.gd. (3) was the test's own unit error, not a module defect: it passed force = 40.0 into strike_drain, whose contract is 0.0..1.0, so one strike cost 3.22 instead of 0.056 and floored the tank on strikes alone; corrected to 0.45 and the assertion passes. Wired into the real engine in R84, a man finishes a 3x5 at 57-66 stamina - G30's own predicted band once the corner's minute is counted. Handing the reconciliation over rather than committing a red suite was the right call.
